scope: The additional Mustang OTA after the UI work, following the completed Frankel 2026110403 release. One fresh manual mustang-ota run through os-release.yml, with mustang_publish_ota=true and other inputs default. The existing Mustang worker remains the single execution owner.
access: Use the existing recorded read-access window and original version-1 Mustang identity; no new IAM, keys, credentials or extension.
retainedInputProof: Current on-host bytes remain unproved until the existing signed-input admission reads and verifies them. Source paths and the digest-verified producer allocation are not a current file-existence claim.
